title: Request a GCP project
summary: Get a new Google Cloud project created by the project factory, attached to the right folder and billing account, with your team as owners.

resources.title: Skill: add a GCP project
resources.description: Lets an AI coding assistant write the project file and open the pull request for you.

prerequisites.title: Approved cost centre
prerequisites.description: Cloud spend is charged to it every month.

prerequisites.title: Google group for your team
prerequisites.description: The group becomes owner of the project, e.g. gcp-myteam-admins@example.com.

prerequisites.title: Access to the project-factory repository
prerequisites.description: Read access is enough; you contribute through a pull request.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or BA following this process.

steps.title: Decide the project details
instructions: Choose the environment: dev, test or prod.
Build the name as <app>-<env>, e.g. payments-dev.
Pick the folder that matches your business unit.
Estimate the monthly budget in EUR.

steps.title: Raise the 'New GCP project' request
steps.description: Use the catalogue item 'New GCP project'.
instructions: Enter name, environment, folder, budget, application ID and owner group.

steps.title: Answer the platform team's questions
instructions: Open the request and read the comment from the Cloud Platform team.
Reply in the request with the missing details.

steps.title: Add your project to the project factory
instructions: Create a branch named after your request number.
Fill in name, folder, billing, owner group and labels.
Open a pull request and put the request number in the title.

resources.title: Skill: add a GCP project
resources.description: Lets an AI coding assistant write the project file and open the pull request for you.

steps.title: Review and merge the pull request
Create the project
steps.description: The pipeline runs on merge and creates the project, budget alert and IAM bindings.

steps.title: Check you can open the project
instructions: Open the GCP console and select your new project.
Check your group is listed under IAM as owner.
